prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Upload Photos for Your Custom Companion", "Provide clear photos of your pet or character to generate your custom desktop pet.", "Select Photos"]
1: ["Continue to Controls Guide", "Master Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Quickly access pet settings, toggle visibility, and trigger interactions right from your desktop.", "Right-click system tray icon to hide/show pet", "Click pet directly on desktop to speak or interact", "Launch Pet on Desktop"]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Adopt, customize, and nurture a lively desktop companion that lives right on your screen."]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Arrival", "Your pet is hatching! Browse tips below to learn how to interact with your pet on desktop.", "Tip: Use system tray shortcuts to summon or minimize your pet anytime."]
4: ["Signing in automatically syncs and restores your existing pets across all your desktop devices."]
5: ["How Would You Like to Adopt Your Pet?", "Choose a instant pre-made companion or upload photos to craft your own unique pet."]
6: ["Your pet's adoption certificate is registered and securely saved to your account."]
7: ["Pet generation usually takes 1-2 minutes. We will notify you when your pet is ready!"]
8: ["Look for your pet icon in the system tray to manage settings, bring your pet to the front, or pause interactions."]
9: ["Meet Your Potential Companions"]
